purpose: Compare reference D, RC0 E and RC1 F elapsed search time at the same deterministic dominance-comparison cutoff without streaming per-decision trace formatting.

D_reference.meaning: Same reference dominance predicate; trace-only DOM payload construction is skipped when trace hashing is off.

E_rc0.meaning: Precompute exact direct macro, executable lineage and expanded cost attributes per candidate state.

F_rc1.meaning: RC0 plus stable per-search integer bitmask encodings for direct macro and executable-lineage set-inclusion tests.

instrumentation_controls.note: Untraced comparison reports same logical counters and cutoff. Separate D-vs-RC0 and D-vs-RC1 traced workflows are required to establish exact decision trace parity.

parity_gates: All three arms must reach 150000 dominance comparisons with matching logical counters at the final shared point.
The same frozen checkpoint raw bytes and state digest must be loaded for each arm.
Actual imported behavioral_search.py path and file SHA-256 must match preflight pins.
This is one seed and one bounded prefix; performance ratios are descriptive and not a stable multi-seed claim.
